property_summary: For any caller and any locked guess, after a settle call completes (whether it paid out or not), that caller's guess block must be cleared so a second settle reverts; the buggy version leaves the block set, allowing repeated settle calls that can drain the contract for a valid guessed blockhash.
change_summary: Delete the reset of the caller's guess block to zero, so a successful or failed settle does not clear the recorded guess block.
